<div class="card-body">
'''Romas 'Lock' Navander''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ロマス“ロック”ナヴァンダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力と回避値に1を加える。相手は彼と同じロケーションに対して、あるいはそこから、リアクションとして移動することができない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Romas-Lock-Navander-PSA-89232344.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コレリア人のパイロット。アカデミーを卒業した直後に帝国軍を脱走した。エコー基地の通信技術士官。近隣の反乱軍の宇宙船に通信を中継する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Romas 'Lock' Navander.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 1 to power and maneuver of a starship he pilots. Opponent may not move as a react to or from the same location as him.

'''Lore:'''
A Corellian pilot. He defected from the Empire just after graduating from the Academy. Communications technician at Echo Base. He relays communications to nearby Rebel starships.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title uses “ロック” in double quotes.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Romas 'Lock' Navander]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
